stemMd: A runner completes one lap of a closed track and returns to the starting point in 60 s. What is the runner's average velocity over the lap?
explanationMd: Average velocity is total displacement divided by elapsed time. Returning to the start gives zero displacement, even though distance travelled and average speed are positive.

distractorRationale.d: Time alone cannot determine a speed.
distractorRationale.b: This is average speed, not velocity.
distractorRationale.e: That is not an average displacement rate.
